card.name: Outdated page and update notices
card.fires_on: Words inside web notices saying a page is no longer updated or pointing readers to a newer post, such as 'no longer being updated and' or '[Update:' and 'Please see my latest post'.

modes.label: Archive notice
modes.description: Words in a note saying the site is no longer updated and is kept for archive.
modes.example: Note: This website is no longer being updated<< and>> is being maintained for archive purposes by the

modes.label: Update pointer
modes.description: Words in an added update line telling readers to see a newer post.
modes.example: [Update: 8/17/2010] Please<< see>> my latest post about setting an ad hoc

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about newer content and redirecting readers, such as 'newer' and 'now available'.
card.plain: It fires on notices saying a web page is out of date or that a newer version exists.
